title: REQ · Config structs, example YAML and cmd wiring contain no worker or execution keys
summary: No worker or execution setting is defined, defaulted, validated, loaded or wired
description: Context: config.go defines Config with Server, Auth, Git, Hosting, Storage, Contribution, Admin and Round only; applyEnv has no worker overrides; config.example.yaml has the same sections; main.go reads only Server.Addr. Desired behavior: this stays true and is guarded so a removed key cannot return. Expected result: a test fails if a worker or execution key reappears in the struct, the example YAML or the env overrides. Why: keeps the repo free of development automation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Config type, when its top-level fields are listed by reflection, then they are exactly Server, Auth, Git, Hosting, Storage, Contribution, Admin and Round
Given config.example.yaml, when decoded into a map, then its top-level keys are exactly server, auth, git, hosting, storage, contribution, admin, round
Given a YAML containing a worker section, when LoadFS runs, then the section is ignored and no config field carries it

in_scope: Confirm config.go and main.go hold no removed keys

technical_constraints: Do not add new config keys
